# SkillSwap - Skill Exchange Platform

SkillSwap is a modern web application that connects people to exchange skills, learn together, and build meaningful community relationships. Our platform enables users to discover matches, chat in real-time, and grow through collaborative learning.

## Overview

SkillSwap helps individuals find skill-sharing partners within a vibrant community. Users can create profiles highlighting their skills and interests, connect with others, and engage in real-time conversations to coordinate their learning exchanges.

## Key Features

- **User Profiles**: Create detailed profiles showcasing your skills and interests
- **Smart Matching**: Discover compatible skill-exchange partners
- **Real-time Chat**: Communicate instantly with connections using WebSocket technology
- **Connection Management**: Send, receive, and manage connection requests
- **Video Integration**: Support for Jitsi-based video calls (coming soon)
- **Dark Mode**: Fully responsive dark/light theme support

## Technology Stack

SkillSwap is built with modern web technologies including React, Redux Toolkit for state management, Tailwind CSS for styling, and Socket.IO for real-time communication. Our responsive design ensures a great experience across all devices.

For questions or feedback, please [contact us](https://skillswap2.vercel.app/contact-us).
